title: 美联储哈马克：通胀超目标已五年，连续冲击下通胀心态会否扎根？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Current conditions in the United States indicate that output is growing at a solid pace, and the labor market remains close to my definition of maximum employment.
segments.zh: 美国当前状况显示，产出正稳步增长，劳动力市场仍接近我对充分就业的定义。

segments.en: But inflation remains elevated, and it has now run above the FOMC's 2% inflation objective for more than five years. The inflation outlook continues to be highly uncertain
segments.zh: 但通胀仍处高位，已连续五年多高于FOMC的2%目标。通胀前景仍高度不确定，

segments.en: with risks tilted to the upside. One aspect that is proving especially challenging for monetary policy is the extended sequence of shocks that we've recently faced from both the supply side via
segments.zh: 风险偏向上行。货币政策面临的一个尤其棘手的问题是，我们近期遭遇了一连串冲击，既来自供给侧，

segments.en: tariffs and oil prices, as well as from the demand side, from the boom and capital spending related to AI. The conventional view is that monetary policy should look through a supply shock.
segments.zh: 包括关税和油价，也来自需求侧，即与AI相关的繁荣和资本支出。传统观点认为，货币政策应忽略供给冲击。

segments.en: The thinking behind that, as all of you well know, is that supply shocks tend to be transitory and lead to a one-time increase in the price level rather than a persistent increase in inflation
segments.zh: 正如各位所知，其背后的逻辑是，供给冲击往往是暂时的，会导致价格水平一次性上升，而非通胀或通胀预期持续攀升。

segments.en: or inflation expectations. Thus policy makers can look through them when determining the appropriate path of policy. But when the environment is more prone to shocks, or the shocks arrive one after
segments.zh: 因此，决策者在确定合适的政策路径时可以忽略它们。但当环境更易受冲击影响，或冲击接踵而至，

segments.en: another, in a period when inflation has been elevated for years, there's a greater risk that an inflationary mindset could take hold. The longer that high inflation persists, the more challenging
segments.zh: 且在通胀已高企多年的时期，通胀心态扎根的风险更大。高通胀持续越久，

segments.en: and costly it can be to bring it back down.
segments.zh: 将其降回目标就越具挑战性、代价也越高。
